notes.title: Build & Save
notes.content:
📦 Release Notes 0.5New FeaturesBuilding System
Town Centre

Opens only when you click it (no longer auto-opens on interact).

Maximum of 1 placeable.

Mining Camp & Woodcutting Camp

Automatically gather stone and wood.

Maximum of 3 placeable.

Upgrades: increase collect range and unlock additional stone/wood types for auto-collect.

Houses

No functionality yet; will later affect the unit cap.
Controls & Options
Camera rotation added via the arrow keys.

Options > Temporary “Camp Removal”: stuck/softlocked? Remove camps from the menu.
Note: this applies only to camps; Town Centre and Houses are not removed.
Audio & Music
Added a new main theme (soundtrack).
Saves
The new save layer now stores:

Building positions

Upgrades

Unit positions
Improvements
UI revamp: cleaner look and clearer navigation.
Bug Fixes
Cross-selection: fixed an issue where the selection box could remain stuck.
Known Issues & Workarounds
Audio slider + gamepad: with a gamepad connected, unintended input can push the audio slider to the left.
Workaround: temporarily disconnect your controller. We’re monitoring frequency and working on a proper fix.

notes.title: Fixes & UI Polish
notes.content:
📦 Release Notes 0.4✅ Bug Fixes
Floating trees have been grounded — no more unintended levitation.

Characters no longer float above the ground.

Bottom UI buttons no longer select multiple units at once.
🛠️ Improvements
Upgrade cost reduced for better game balance.

Resource progression bar added to show gathering progress.

Distant objects no longer turn black — improved visual consistency.
🎨 UI / UX Updates
Action buttons now show unit status:

Idle – character is doing nothing

Interacting – character is busy

Selected – currently selected unit/button
